title: Monthly spending insights
description: An AI read-out of a user's finances for one month: a headline, sentiment-tagged insights, and suggestions.

headline.description: The single most important takeaway for the month, in one plain-language sentence.

summary.description: One or two sentences expanding on the headline with the key numbers.

insights.description: Two to five specific, quantified observations about the month.

sentiment.description: Whether this observation is a good sign, something to watch, or a neutral fact.

title.description: A short label for the insight, e.g. 'Under budget by $240'.

detail.description: One sentence explaining the insight with the relevant figure.

suggestions.description: Up to three concrete, actionable suggestions. Empty array if none are useful.

savingsRatePct.description: The month's savings rate as a percentage (net ÷ income × 100). Null when income is zero.
